items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I went, worked with the, with the, uh, uh, the Vaudeville act, uh, show, this, uh, Miller... And I, I worked in there for, for a while

ctx.x: from Chicago here. That's the best part. Came here in about 1920? About 1920. Yeah, that's

about 1920 I came to Chicago. And so I've been here, working around here. What did you start at up here? Do you remember your first band? Well, I started, I came here, the job I came here after, I don't know what happened. The fella, what did happen after this. Something happened that I couldn't go on that job on account of some union. Yes. Yeah. I understand. And so I stayed around here and I went, worked with the, with the, uh, uh, the Vaudeville act, uh, show, this, uh, Miller, what is his name, uh, uh, uh,…
I forget, where were the entertainers on State Street, or? Uh, uh, entertainers on 35th,
